brief.objective: WRITE-BACK FIX (owner-pulled-forward: the single blocker on the dashboard's Usage/cost section AND honest fleet states). THE DEFECT: attempts dispatched through the tool path (bundlebees_dispatch) never write completion events to the plugin's outbox - only the job-CLI path writes rizzstack.bee.landed.v1 events (see bundlebees_plugin agent_consumer / event-outbox code: the emission is coupled to the job lifecycle). Consequences: (a) the attempt store keeps dispatch-time states forever (fleet section shows unknown/stale rows; in_flight honesty depends on staleness heuristics), (b) the usage ingest service (reads outbox bee-landed events) never sees tool-path attempts, so token/cost per model/repo stays empty, (c) the reconciliation sweep cannot distinguish completed-from-unpushed without origin deltas. THE FIX: emit the same landed/terminal event for tool-path attempts when their state reaches a terminal value (succeeded, failed, cancelled, interrupted) - same schema rizzstack.bee.landed.v1, same outbox write path, with attempt_id + state + feature/branch + whatever usage payload the result envelope carries. RED-FIRST: a test that dispatches/records a tool-path attempt completion and asserts the outbox event exists - fails on main, passes on the branch. Keep the emission side-effect-free on failure (best-effort write, never break the attempt completion path). Result MUST be committed on your branch feat/tool-path-write-back BEFORE ending the turn (the coordinator pushes via verify).
